review_candidates.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer (Remote, EST hours)
review_candidates.description: Hi! I'm Emma, co-founder at JuniGo. I'm looking for a Full-Stack Software Engineer to join our product and tech team. Below is some context on why we're hiring, what you'll own, and the things you probably want to know before you apply. BACKGROUND & WHY WE ARE HIRING JuniGo helps small and medium businesses in Africa pay their suppliers in Asia and around the world, and we are starting our footprint in Nigeria. The region was not a random choice. Nigerian businesses move real goods at real scale: China alone shipped nearly $25 billion worth of goods to Nigeria in 2025. Yet the businesses behind that trade are badly underserved. Slow, expensive payment infrastructure and little access to funding hold them back. We're building the financial infrastructure emerging markets deserve. And it's working. We launched in January 2026 and have grown 200x since. In October alone, we processed US$26.6 million in total payment volume (TPV). We're growing fast, and there's more worth building than we have people to build it. Our tech team today is 3 engineers, all based in Asia. For us this means: Partner integrations are queuing up. We have several new partner integrations in the pipeline, and each one is waiting its turn. We're leaving good opportunities on the table. We've found some really good opportunities in the market, but we don't have the people to go after them. Our engineers are spread too thin. They switch between too many workstreams at once, which slows everything down. Nobody covers the other half of the day. When customers and partners need something during North American hours, there's no engineer online. That's where you come in. I'm looking for a full-stack engineer who can own features from start to finish, and who can be our engineering presence on EST time. SCOPE OF THE ROLE & SOME EXAMPLES You'll own features end to end: from a rough idea to code running in production, across the backend, web, and our iOS and Android apps. Example 1: Owning a feature from idea to launch You won't always get a polished design file or a detailed spec. Sometimes it's a rough wireframe. Sometimes it's a few lines of high-level requirements. You'll: Work out what the customer actually needs, and fill in the gaps with your own judgement Design the API, build the backend, and build the screens on web and mobile Make sensible product and UX calls when there's no detailed design, and check the important ones with me Figure things out step by step, without waiting for every detail to be spelled out Ship it, watch how it's used, and keep improving it Example 2: Connecting JuniGo to new partners Reading a partner's API docs and turning them into a working integration Handling everything that goes wrong in real life: timeouts, duplicate callbacks, payments stuck in an unclear status Making sure every transfer can be traced and reconciled, so we always know where a customer's money is Working directly with partners' tech teams to sort out issues Example 3: Keeping things running on EST time Being the go-to engineer while the rest of the team in Asia is asleep: handling production issues and urgent requests from customers and partners Building the monitoring, alerting and clear error states that catch problems before a customer messages us Handing over cleanly to the team in Asia at the end of your day, which sometimes means joining evening meetings TEAM STRUCTURE You'll report directly to me. You'll join a tech team of 3 engineers based in Asia, plus our PM. This role is fully remote. We don't mind where you live, as long as you can reliably work EST hours. You'll often be the only engineer online during your day, so you'll need to be comfortable making calls on your own. You'll work closely with: Our engineers in Asia , with handovers at both ends of your day (including some evening meetings to hand things off) Our PM , on priorities and requirements Operations and sales , who talk to customers every day and will tell you quickly when something isn't working Our banking and payments partners , on integrations and incidents THE STACK TypeScript + React → our web and mobile apps Go → backend services PostgreSQL → our main database AWS → infrastructure Blockchain → part of how we hold and move funds Custom internal admin tools for operations, compliance and sales REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCES Full-stack experience shipping real products, including mobile apps on iOS and Android. You're comfortable moving between the backend, web and mobile in the same week. Hands-on with our stack: TypeScript, React, Go and PostgreSQL. Experience in payments and blockchain. You know how money flows, through different networks. You own features end to end. You take something from an idea to production and keep looking after it after launch. You're good with ambiguity. Give you a rough wireframe or a high-level requirement, and you'll use your judgement, taste and initiative to work it out step by step. Experience integrating with third-party APIs. You know why idempotency matters when money is moving. Product sense. You ask "why" before "how", and you'll tell us when something doesn't make sense for the customer. You can reliably work EST hours. Fluent in Mandarin and English, written and spoken. Both are required. Our team works in both, and our partners are from anywhere in the world. Nice-to-haves Familiarity with cross-border trade or trade financing Experience with KYC/AML or other regulated environments Early-stage startup experience WHAT WE ARE OFFERING Real impact. What you build moves real money for real businesses every day. Real ownership. You'll own features and integrations end to end. Have an idea that makes the product better? Make the case and go build it. Compensation. 90k-120k USD, plus equity through our employee share plan as one of our earliest employees. Fully remote. Work from wherever you like, as long as you cover EST hours. Unlimited vacation. Take time off when you need it. Work directly with the founders. No layers between you and the people making decisions. Early days. We're still early, with a long road ahead. The people who join now will help shape what JuniGo becomes, and grow with it. AN HONEST HEADS-UP This isn't your typical SDE job. Expect some intense days. Requirements won't always be fully defined, priorities can shift quickly, and during your hours you'll often be the one people turn to. But if you're actually looking to own something end to end and see the actual impact it's making in global trades in emerging markets, then this might be the job for you.

review_candidates.title: Senior Avionics Software Engineer (DO-178C) / Technical Lead
review_candidates.description: MANNARINO Systems & Software Inc. is a leader in providing safety-critical systems, software, hardware and certification engineering services to the aerospace, defense, space, simulation & power generation industries. Our customer base is very large, covering traditional aerospace companies as well as new and exciting markets, including electric propulsion, Urban Air Mobility, Unmanned Aerial Vehicle and autonomous flight. The MANNARINO culture is focused on high quality, hard work, professionalism and teamwork within a highly respectful, motivating atmosphere geared towards long-term business growth. As a member of our team, you will benefit from: a comprehensive group insurance and RRSP plan a flextime policy with paid overtime discretionary bonuses a fitness reimbursement program other office perks such as catered weekly lunches and free hot beverages (espresso, coffee, hot chocolate and tea) regular company outings Career Opportunity and Primary Roles / Responsibilities We are looking for a Senior Avionics Software Specialist to support the development and verification of safety-critical embedded software for aerospace applications. This is a hands-on technical position for an experienced avionics software engineer who can contribute throughout the software development lifecycle while also acting as a technical reference and mentor for less-experienced engineers. The mandate covers software requirements, development, verification, configuration management and the engineering activities required to achieve key program milestones, including Safety of Flight and software qualification. The ideal candidate combines strong DO-178C, C and/or Ada expertise with the communication and leadership skills needed to coach junior engineers, review their work, explain engineering practices and help the broader team deliver high-quality software. The existing team already includes experienced software and DO-178C specialists, so this person will complement that expertise rather than coming in to redefine the organization's engineering approach. Key Responsibilities Embedded Software Development Develop safety-critical embedded avionics software in accordance with DO-178C and applicable project processes. Define and review High-Level Requirements (HLR) and Low-Level Requirements (LLR) based on system specifications. Maintain requirements traceability throughout the software development lifecycle. Design and implement software functions primarily using C and/or Ada. Work within established project development standards, tools and software environments. Embedded Software Development Review software development artifacts for technical quality and compliance. Develop software test cases and test procedures. Perform unit, integration, validation and verification activities. Execute tests, analyze results and contribute to the resolution of software anomalies. Support the production of coverage analysis, verification documentation and other evidence required by the applicable certification and project processes. Configuration & Change Management Follow established software configuration management processes. Support software change management and problem-report resolution. Maintain the integrity and traceability of software artifacts as they evolve through the project lifecycle. Technical Leadership & Mentoring Act as a senior technical resource for the software engineering team. Mentor and support junior software engineers as they develop their avionics and DO-178C capabilities. Help less-experienced engineers understand requirements, development, verification and certification practices. Conduct technical reviews and provide constructive guidance on requirements, code, test cases and other engineering artifacts. Help onboard engineers into established engineering processes, tools and ways of working. Collaborate with the team's existing software and DO-178C experts, providing additional technical depth and day-to-day coaching capacity. Required Competencies Approximately 5-10+ years of relevant avionics or closely related embedded software experience. Strong experience developing embedded software in an avionics environment governed by DO-178C. Strong programming experience with C and/or Ada. Demonstrated experience across several stages of the software lifecycle, including: HLR/LLR development requirements traceability software design and implementation unit testing integration verification and validation Experience reviewing technical software artifacts and providing guidance to other engineers. Ability to mentor, coach and onboard junior engineers. Strong communication and collaboration skills in multidisciplinary engineering teams. Comfortable working within an established engineering framework and adapting to customer processes and standards rather than attempting to replace them. Preferred Competencies Experience acting as a Technical Lead, Software Lead, Technical Authority, Senior Developer or technical mentor in an embedded software environment. Experience supporting DO-178C certification/qualification activities and associated documentation. Experience with software coverage analysis. Experience taking junior engineers through requirements, implementation, verification and technical review activities. Previous aerospace, flight-control or safety-critical systems experience. Miscellaneous Requirements The work model is hybrid (at least 3 days at the office in Montreal). Professional proficiency in spoken and written French is mandatory. Occasional travel may be required based on project needs. Canadian Citizenship or Permanent Residency is required. Knowledge of English is required to communicate and work with customers outside the province of Quebec. / La connaissance de l'anglais est requise pour communiquer et travailler avec nos clients situés à l'extérieur de la province de Québec. At MANNARINO, we believe that passion and a desire to learn is crucial. Diversity of thought and experiences leads to innovative solutions and creativity. This is why we would like to encourage all those interested to apply. We are an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be held in strict confidence. Only those selected for interview will be contacted.

review_candidates.title: Embedded Software Engineer - DO 178
review_candidates.description: Company Description CS Group Canada, a subsidiary of CS Group, is a leader in the development and certification of safety-critical systems in the aerospace, electric and autonomous driving industries. Joining CS Group Canada is a unique opportunity to work on complex high-tech systems for the most prestigious system manufacturers in North America, and our employees benefit from competitive salaries, complete benefits, and flexible work location and schedule. Job Description Today CS Group Canada is looking for a Software Verification Engineer. Their role will be to test embedded software applications on aircraft and space system such as engine control, flight management systems and display/avionics systems. The role may evolve to perform software development. Responsibilities Carry out the software testing in accordance with DO-178. Develop and run the relevant tests on the test platforms to verify correctness of design. Debug issues (raised during the software development cycle) in the engine control software. Ensure traceability between all the software design and tests artefacts. Conduct independent peer reviews on tests produced by other team members. Draft all the final technical documents. Provide a clear status and workload to your lead. Participate to continuous improvement of the team performance (quality, efficiency, on-time delivery). Qualifications Requirements: Bachelor degree in Electrical, Mechanical or Computer Science or equivalent. 2-6 years experience in a similar position. Experience with engine control software. Interest in troubleshoot complex software problems. Knowledge of DO-178. Knowledge of C language, and scripting languages like Python. Knowledge of SCADE, Matlab / Simulink or equivalent. Knowledge of testing tools Rational RTRT and / or LDRA. Software Knowledge: Microsoft Office, DOORS, SVN. Basic knowledge in communication protocols such as CAN, ARINC, RS-422, Ethernet. Good communication, interpersonal skills, team-player. Curiosity, autonomy, pro-activity and ability to find solutions and compromises. Additional Information Proficiency in English is required to communicate professionally with our clients and partners outside Québec, as well as to participate in technical activities related to the projects. Please note that only selected candidates will be contacted. Job Types : Full-time, Permanent CS Group Canada values diversity in the workplace and encourages women, visible minorities, ethnic minorities, aboriginal people, and people with disabilities to apply. Benefits Hybrid Work Industry leading medical, dental, and vision Insurance Access to a telemedicine service RRSP program Personal and sick days Recreation room with pool table and foosball table All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
